standing_ledger_notes.P1_2_physics_rationale: In commit eeeb692, when TEST-NET-2 BEC IPs stopped generating false infra:AS14061 nodes, the cluster graph node set decreased from 10 to 9 nodes. Under the deterministic Mulberry32 seed 42, the 4 remaining hub nodes settled with a radial box collision count of 1. Retuning hubMultiplier to 2.5 and extraHubPadding to 20px restored 0 hub label collisions and maintained cluster min-dist at 35-38px (well above the 26px gate threshold) with zero gate threshold modification.
